facts.fact: Some studies show that businesses with consistent NAP listings see up to 33% higher revenue growth than inconsistent competitors (vendor-cited, unnamed studies).
facts.quote: some studies show that businesses with consistent **NAP** listings see up to **33% higher revenue growth** than their inconsistent competitors.

facts.fact: The vendor states that clean NAP data helped boost local search rankings by an average of 20-30% for its clients.
facts.quote: We've seen clean **NAP** data help boost local search rankings by an average of **20-30%**

facts.fact: Research cited by the vendor shows 73% of users lose trust in a brand when they find inaccurate business information online.
facts.quote: Research shows a staggering **73% of users lose trust in a brand** when they find inaccurate business information online.

facts.fact: Adwave cites recent studies (via a DesignRush statistics page) reporting that 68% of companies directly attribute 10-20% of their revenue growth to maintaining brand consistency.
facts.quote: recent studies show that **68% of companies** directly attribute **10-20% of their revenue growth** to maintaining brand consistency.

facts.fact: Per the cited branding statistics, 33% of businesses reported a revenue increase of over 20% after achieving brand consistency.
facts.quote: A significant **33% of businesses** reported a revenue increase of over **20%** after achieving consistency

facts.fact: Per the cited branding statistics, 60% of businesses landed in the 10-20% revenue growth range after achieving consistency.
facts.quote: while **60%** landed in that 10-20% growth range.

facts.fact: Per the cited branding statistics, inconsistent listings can cause a revenue drop of up to 23% due to poor uniformity.
facts.quote: inconsistent listings can cause a revenue drop of up to **23%** due to poor uniformity

facts.fact: Adwave recommends manually checking the most critical listings (such as Google Business Profile, Facebook, and Yelp) every quarter when managing NAP by spreadsheet.
facts.quote: typically using a spreadsheet to check your most critical listings every quarter.

facts.fact: The page states that a full-scale NAP cleanup project typically delivers its most significant results in 1-3 months.
facts.quote: A full-scale NAP cleanup project typically delivers its most significant results in **1-3 months**.

facts.fact: The page states that after cleaning up major platforms like Google Business Profile, a positive shift in local rankings could be noticed in just a few days to a week.
facts.value: a few days to a week
facts.quote: you could notice a positive shift in your local rankings in just a few days to a week.

facts.fact: The page states that for smaller directories and data aggregators, it can take several weeks, or even a couple of months, for new correct information to propagate.

facts.quote: For all the smaller directories and data aggregators out there, it can take several weeks, or even a couple of months

facts.fact: The page advises businesses to always use the name customers know them by, citing Google's guidelines that favor using the real-world 'doing business as' (DBA) name.
facts.quote: Google’s own guidelines back this up, they want you to use your real-world, "doing business as" (DBA) name
